title: Canon at the fifth: find the second voice
intro: This melody is a two-voice canon, but not at the unison. Find when the second voice comes in (within the first two bars) and at what interval.
source: Written for Canon Workbench as a practice piece.
hints: Try the unison first and listen: where does it go wrong?
The second voice comes in at the start of a bar.
The melody uses D, E, F#, A. Which transposition keeps those notes in D major and sounds good above them?
